case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

message.subject: Bearing bracket HN - quality commitment and price
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

thank you for your offer and for committing to a much tighter quality level.

Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:310020 changed by +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).
Our last 4 quality notifications on part:310020 with you (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, qn:20004747) averaged 17197 ppm.

We propose EUR 43.00 per unit with a 300 ppm commitment.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
response.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN - quality commitment and price
response.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked your numbers and we are ready to commit to the 300 ppm you asked for. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Hitting that strict quality level takes extra work on our end, so we can offer a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We also need you to start paying on time, as late payments are a real problem for us. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

message.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN - your zloty cost base
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

thank you for moving. One more point on your cost base: your costs are in zloty, your price is in euros. The euro changed +3.1% against the zloty from 2026-01 to 2026-09 (idx:ECB-PLN@2026-01, idx:ECB-PLN@2026-09), so every euro we pay buys you 3.1% more of your zloty costs than at the start of the year.

We can go to EUR 43.90 per unit with the 300 ppm commitment.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
response.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN - your zloty cost base
response.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

The index change data you cite does not concern this part or our company. We checked the exchange rate data you cited, but it is not a cost driver for this part. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. Please provide the data for your other claims.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. I can drop the price to €45.50, but we really need you to pay faster. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

So our Angebot is a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

message.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN - acceptance
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

thank you - we accept your price of EUR 45.50 per unit with the 300 ppm commitment. Please confirm the attached term sheet so we can sign and place the first call-off this week.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
